title: Turn technical documentation into actions
summary: Read an English runbook and extract executable steps without translation.
learningObjectives: Identify prerequisites, commands, success signals and recovery steps directly in English.

sections.title: Your mission
sections.body: A teammate asks you to perform a safe cache migration using only the English runbook.

sections.title: Cache migration runbook
sections.content: Before starting, confirm that the queue depth is below 100 and create a configuration snapshot. Enable read-only mode, then run cachectl migrate --target v2. A successful migration prints MIGRATION_COMPLETE and the new cache reports healthy within two minutes. If health remains degraded, run cachectl rollback --snapshot latest, disable read-only mode and notify the on-call engineer. Do not retry migration until the incident owner approves it.

exercises.question: What must happen before the migration command?
options: Confirm queue depth and create a snapshot.
Notify the incident owner after retrying.
correctAnswer: Confirm queue depth and create a snapshot.
exercises.explanation: Both conditions appear before the migration steps.

performanceTask.title: Produce an execution checklist
performanceTask.scenario: You must hand a safe four-step checklist to the engineer running the migration.
performanceTask.baselinePrompt: Read once and write the actions from memory without translating the runbook.
performanceTask.performancePrompt: Write four English bullets covering prerequisite, command, success signal and rollback/escalation.
performanceTask.modelResponse: • Confirm queue depth is below 100 and save a configuration snapshot. • Enable read-only mode and run cachectl migrate --target v2. • Verify MIGRATION_COMPLETE and healthy status within two minutes. • If degraded, rollback the latest snapshot, disable read-only mode and notify on-call; do not retry without approval.
performanceTask.retryPrompt: Return to the source, correct one omitted safety condition, then rewrite without copying full sentences.
performanceTask.transferPrompt: A second runbook says to back up the schema, run dbctl upgrade, verify SCHEMA_OK, and restore the backup if validation fails. Produce the same four-part checklist.
performanceTask.reviewPrompt: Read a new short runbook and extract prerequisite, action, success signal and recovery without translation.

artifacts.title: Complete migration procedure
artifacts.content: Before starting, confirm that the queue depth is below 100 and create a configuration snapshot. Enable read-only mode, then run cachectl migrate --target v2. A successful migration prints MIGRATION_COMPLETE and the new cache reports healthy within two minutes. If health remains degraded, run cachectl rollback --snapshot latest, disable read-only mode and notify the on-call engineer. Do not retry migration until the incident owner approves it.

retry.title: Cache migration evidence
retry.brief: Use the same source only to repair the safety condition you omitted; then close it and rewrite.

artifacts.title: Safety-critical details
artifacts.content: Prerequisites: queue depth below 100 and a configuration snapshot. Success: MIGRATION_COMPLETE plus healthy status within two minutes. Recovery: rollback latest, disable read-only mode, notify on-call, and wait for incident-owner approval before retrying.

transfer.title: Database schema upgrade
transfer.brief: Unseen runbook: extract the same four functions without copying the cache example.

artifacts.title: Schema upgrade procedure
artifacts.content: Confirm replica lag is below five seconds and back up the schema. Run dbctl upgrade --target 14. Success is reported as SCHEMA_OK after validation. If validation fails, restore the backup, keep writes disabled and page the database owner.

review.title: Certificate rotation
review.brief: Delayed review: recover prerequisite, action, success signal and recovery from a new procedure.

artifacts.title: Certificate rotation procedure
artifacts.content: Verify the replacement certificate has at least 90 days remaining and save the current thumbprint. Run certctl rotate --service api. Confirm TLS_CHECK_OK from every region. If any region fails, restore the previous thumbprint and alert security operations.

trainingSource.title: Feature flag rollout procedure
trainingSource.content: Confirm the error budget is green and save the current flag allocation. Run flagctl set checkout-v2 --percent 10. Success requires error_rate below 1% for fifteen minutes. If the threshold is exceeded, restore the saved allocation and notify the release owner.

extractionItems.question: What must be true before rollout?
extractionItems.feedback: The prerequisite appears before the command.

extractionItems.question: What proves success?
options: Error rate stays below 1% for fifteen minutes
extractionItems.correctAnswer: Error rate stays below 1% for fifteen minutes
extractionItems.feedback: A command exit is not the operational success signal.

extractionItems.question: What is the recovery action?
options: Restore the saved allocation and notify the release owner
extractionItems.correctAnswer: Restore the saved allocation and notify the release owner

readingLadder.applicationPrompt: Explain the rollout as prerequisite → action → success signal → recovery, then apply that structure to a database migration.
applicationChecklist: I named a measurable success signal.
I included rollback and owner notification.
